title: G DATA Total Security Backup Service Uncontrolled Search Path Element Local Privilege Escalation… (CVE-2026-19779)
description: CVE-2026-19779 is a local privilege escalation vulnerability in the Backup Service component of G DATA Total Security. It arises from an uncontrolled search path element where the service restores archives from an unsecured location. Exploitation requires an attacker to already have the ability to execute low-privileged code on the system. Successful exploitation allows arbitrary code execution with SYSTEM privileges, leading to full system compromise.
